title: Publish a reproducible R-042 generator and independently repeat the rate sweep
statement: Rerunning the current vs.redteam.fact_attack with cut book and each submission’s first_lines when present reproduces the six practice measurements in P-G-025. R-028: F-005 0.169454, F-013 2.032998, F-014 0.687280; R-042: 0.180215, 2.092275, 0.609345. The corresponding manuscript values are 0.230432, 1.940360, 0.710540. R-028 passes all three fact thresholds, R-042 misses F-014. This checks the two fixed outputs only; it does not test seed-to-seed variation or the slope in the proposed sweep. The two original PR #672 files contain one generated sample and a prose recipe, not an executable generator or exact pseudocode; the P-G-025 proposal likewise contains the sweep values but no replay artifact. Key implementation details including random-call order and fallback behavior are not recoverable from the sample alone, so a new implementation cannot be represented as a reproduction of R-042.
check: Publish or obtain a deterministic generator implementation or fully specified pseudocode, pinned training-input hashes, exact layout rules and all parameter values, RNG and seeds; first reproduce a disclosed fixed-seed text hash. Freeze a schedule of at least 20 independent seeds for each chain-new-word rate 0, .05, .10, .15, .25. Run the existing practice scorer with cut book, report each statistic and seed, uncertainty of trends and non-monotonicity, and separately test other generator families before claiming a general trade-off. Keep unrun sweep and observed fixed samples separate; never infer hidden-page membership.

evidence.method: Run the included script from repository root after pinned input fetch. It reads only public practice output and published synthetic text; fact_attack lays whole-book text in public page order and evaluates the practice split.
evidence.reproduction_python:
import json
from vs import redteam
for author in ['mtx-light','giffordino']:
 x=json.load(open('experiments/G-every-fact/'+author+'/attack.json'))
 for fid in ['F-005','F-013','F-014']:
  result=redteam.fact_attack(fid,x['lines'],'practice',cut=x['cut'],first_lines=x.get('first_lines'))
  print(author,fid,json.dumps(result),flush=True)
evidence.limits: The attack replay is not a generator replication. The public recipes do not fix all stochastic choices; no new seeds or novel text were produced. Practice values are descriptive and not new held-out results.
